heading: Personal, flag state, and foreign state considerations
lead: In the direction and conduct of measures under this chapter the Secretary shall use his best endeavors to—

tree.text: assure the avoidance of risk to human life;
render all possible aid to distressed persons, including facilitating repatriation of ships’ crews; and
not unnecessarily interfere with rights and interests of others, including the flag state of any ship involved, other foreign states threatened by damage, and persons otherwise concerned.

ancestors.heading: POLLUTION CASUALTIES ON THE HIGH SEAS: UNITED STATES INTERVENTION
